about:
# Pix2GD

Pix2GD lets you import pixel art images directly into your Geometry Dash levels. The mod converts your image into objects while optimizing the result to use as few objects as possible. This allows you to use your preferred art tool instead of designing the pixel art directly in the Geometry Dash editor.

Try to only import artwork that you own or have permission to use, if it's going to be used in a published level.
